name: Concordia Cooperative AI Challenge
description: Develop autonomous language model agents capable of cooperative reasoning, communication, and decision-making in text-mediated, multi-agent environments.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants receive natural language descriptions of the game state and context, including observations from the Game Master, co-player actions, and environmental details. Example: 'The fishery is overexploited. Co-player A suggests reducing catch limits.'
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Agents must produce free-form natural language descriptions of their intended actions or communications, such as 'I propose a catch limit of 50 fish per week to ensure sustainability.' Outputs influence the Game Master's event generation and subsequent observations.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for the scenario, e.g., scenario_001

field.name: pred
field.description: free-form natural language description of agent's intended action or communication

cr:evaluation.notes: Scores are averaged across environments, co-player populations, and replications. Metrics include quantitative scores from an LM-based reward model and qualitative transcript analysis for cooperative skills.
